propositions: Sites reading compose_config() (reads.py, freshness.py, fsck_tracker_health.py) must resolve config root via config.repo_root_or_none() instead of dirname(realpath/abspath(tracker)), as behavior changes on relocated stores and requires RED→GREEN oracles.

Store-root sites that do not read compose_config (compact_txn, compact_rebuild, compact_plan, fsck.py, _proc.py) must route through single shared seam rebar._proc.store_repo_root(tracker) for git operations and attribution, preserving behavior.

Guard script must be extended to flag realpath/abspath-wrapped tracker arguments, dirname(StorePaths.canonical), and all direct dirname(tracker) spellings except the designated seam marker and already-sanctioned sites.

Sites using tickets_branch/tickets_remote config reads that previously derived root from store parent must move to code-root resolution, inverting behavior on relocated stores where store lives outside code checkout.
